description: This Java class 'ReferenceController' is a Spring MVC controller handling AJAX requests related to geographical references such as provinces, countries, zones, and credit card date info. It provides endpoints for retrieving province lists, country names, zone names, and credit card date options, utilizing services and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling AJAX requests related to geographical references and credit card date info.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve list of provinces (zones) for a given country code and language.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a country given its country code, considering request language.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Returns the name of a zone given its zone code, considering request language.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of upcoming years for credit card expiration date selection, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of months (01 to 12) for credit card expiration date selection, utilizing cache.
